title: Metadata Candidate Durable Review
problem: Provider Candidate Graph previews are useful operator evidence, but they currently disappear after refresh and should not become implicit accepted Provider Mapping writes.
gates: JSONL validation for docs/workstreams/metadata-candidate-durable-review/TASKS.jsonl, CAMPAIGNS.jsonl, and CONTEXT.jsonl

evidence.summary: Opened the Metadata Candidate Durable Review lane from provider-depth follow-on selection.
Added a pure redaction-safe Metadata Candidate Review plan contract from MetadataCandidateGraph without schema or Provider Mapping writes.
Added durable Metadata Candidate Review snapshot records, repository trait, SQLite/PostgreSQL baseline tables, adapters, and DB round-trip coverage without Provider Mapping writes.
Added backend-only Metadata Candidate Review decision service with idempotent accept/reject status transitions, stale guards, expiry handling, and no Provider Mapping writes.
Closed the lane and split Admin/Web provider depth governance plus accepted-review Provider Mapping application into explicit follow-ons.
